pages.title: A plant by the water
pages.text: Richnytsia grows both in water and on land, along the rivers of the Beyond.

pages.title: Conduit Power
pages.text: Near a Richnytsia (within $(thing)20 blocks$()) you gain Conduit Power, just as from a conduit: easier breathing underwater, better sight and faster digging.$(br2)If you plan a long time underwater, finding this plant is a good move.
